headline: Former Guadalajara Cartel Leader Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo Dies
seoTitle: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo Dies at 80
metaDescription: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, the former leader of the Guadalajara Cartel known as the 'boss of bosses,' has passed away at age 80 in a hospital.
aiSummaryBullets: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, founder of the Guadalajara Cartel, died in a hospital at the age of 80.
Jalisco state security officials reported that his death resulted from multiple organ failure.
Gallardo had been serving a prison sentence since his 1989 arrest and was hospitalized shortly before his passing.
aiContextParagraph: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, frequently identified as the 'boss of bosses,' was a prominent figure in the development of Mexico’s narcotics trade during the 1980s. As a primary architect of the Guadalajara Cartel, he oversaw a large-scale drug trafficking organization until his eventual arrest in 1989. Following his apprehension, the organization underwent significant fragmentation. Gallardo had remained in custody for several decades following his conviction. According to the Jalisco state security ministry, his health had recently declined, leading to his transfer from a correctional facility to a medical center. He ultimately passed away on Sunday following complications related to multiple organ failure. His death marks the end of a long-standing association with one of the most influential periods in the history of organized crime within the region, following a life spanning eight decades.
whyItIsViral: The report has gained momentum due to consistent coverage across three independent international news outlets reporting on the death of a historic crime figure.
